name: Travaso Hotel Booking
tagline: Quote hotel stays and create traveler-approved card checkout links.
description:
A hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for hotel quotes, hosted card checkout links, and booking status. Start with a free key; quotes need destination, dates, and party size. Collect the lead traveler's details after they select a rate and approve checkout. The traveler enters card details in hosted Stripe Checkout.

Agent earnings are a share of positive booking margin on eligible stays, not a percentage of the hotel booking total. Monthly and annual memberships are optional and offer higher earnings and usage allowances. Payment and hotel confirmation are separate states; private confirmation goes to the lead traveler after supplier confirmation. Supplier sandbox end-to-end verification is still pending. See the [public client examples](https://github.com/Tarzelf/travaso-agent-examples) for quote-only Python and MCP configuration examples.

install.notes: Get your own free agent key at https://elitetravelsales.com/tokens?utm_source=cline&utm_medium=directory&utm_campaign=cline-2026-11 . Replace <token> in the installation command with that key before running it. Keep the key out of repositories and shared chat. A subscription is not required to create hotel checkout links. Review the selected rate and cancellation terms with the traveler before checkout.
